# getvout

> getvout is a design and development team based in Karnal, Haryana, India. We create websites, web applications, online shops, brand identities and workflow automation.

The canonical website is https://getvout.com/en. The website is English-only.
This file is a human-readable discovery aid following the community llms.txt
proposal; it is not a search-index submission, ranking signal or training licence.

## Studio and contact

- [Home](https://getvout.com/en): Overview of our studio and four selected projects.
- [Our work](https://getvout.com/en/work): Eight selected projects, starting with JAC Creation; Rudra Infocom is third and TalScout.ai is last.
- [Our team](https://getvout.com/en/studio): Our approach and collaboration. The studio has 20+ projects overall; eight are selected for this website.
- [Contact](https://getvout.com/en/contact): Email hello@getvout.com for general enquiries or contact@getvout.com for business and privacy questions.
- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/917404511743): +91 7404511743 is WhatsApp-only, not a calling number.

## Important limitations

The enquiry forms do not currently deliver or store messages. Contact the team
by email or WhatsApp instead. Legal notices remain drafts pending confirmation
of business and hosting details. The website does not claim guaranteed search
rankings, sales results, awards or third-party certification.
